checks: No graphics at create; unchanged polling and unattached draw; duplicate/invalid handle rejection.
Discoverable JSON-RPC methods, malformed request/notification behavior, shared-owner/graphics restrictions.
Off-thread calls reject without transferring WorldSession ownership or mutating state.
Independent CLI process shares authoritative revision/entities and stale edits remain atomic.
Camera patches validate before mutation; unavailable captures/invalid HWND preserve authoring.
GPU-independent picking: nearest visible geometry, no-hit, top-left coordinates, true triangle/rotated-box intersections, clipping and strict atomic guards.
Framing combines visible descendants, respects aspect/clipping, preserves orientation, supports non-rendered entities and never edits world bytes.
Runtime picking/framing uses frozen geometry and hierarchy after authored deletion/reparenting without advancing ticks.
GPU-independent skin picking follows edited joint poses and excludes obsolete rest geometry.
Host destruction releases writer ownership and endpoint; frontend HWND survives; committed edits survive reopen.
limitations: Native ABI/HWND automation, not physical Avalonia widget qualification.
No --gpu supplied: real HWND/Vulkan draw/capture/lifecycle checks were not run.

observations: Move/rotate/scale share native geometry/drag math and the existing guarded authored transaction/history path with agent clients.
Preview updates hierarchy, light placement/direction and skin palettes without changing world storage, history, receipts, cached authored snapshots or earlier snapshot copies.
Analytic tests cover camera degeneracy, clipping, rotation unwrapping and affine parent ellipse angles; own local scale is excluded from local rotation ring basis.
The screenshot harness now checks the session lock state before screen capture; rejected lock-screen images were discarded and are not published as editor evidence.
Both GPUs render handles after scene MSAA resolve and include them in captures. Cancel restores capture pixels exactly; resizing and capture/gesture invalidation pass.
GUI checks use owned-HWND mouse/key messages to commit/cancel transforms, undo/redo, preserve dirty drafts and distinguish tool shortcuts from RMB flight.

Integration exposed deferred initial TextChanged callbacks rounding a committed transform into an unsolicited Inspector draft; the qualified build ignores initialization and retired-control callbacks.
limitations: Full-window visual capture was unavailable while Windows was locked. The published image is an actual native Scene capture only; prior desktop images are historical references.
Owned-HWND messages and semantic actions do not qualify physical input, IME, accessibility or arbitrary multi-monitor/DPI behavior.
Axis-only, single-entity manipulation. No plane handles, free rotation, uniform-scale handle, mirrored scales or authored shear.
Degenerate and edge-on handles are hidden. Rotation samples must be less than 180 degrees apart; cursor is not locked or warped.
Scene uses 4x MSAA in these fixtures; overlay pass itself is single-sample and not yet analytically antialiased.
Synchronous UI-thread preview preparation remains a scaling concern for large worlds; these small fixtures do not establish production performance.
Automatic real-time Play, multiselect, material pickers and complete animation/VFX authoring remain unfinished; this milestone does not complete M0/M1/M2.
